title_en: “Beside You, Not Leaving Behind” 44th Infantry Division Visits Vulnerable Groups and Expresses Concern to the People
summary_en: The 44th Special Forces Ranger Corps, led by Lieutenant Colonel Suppachit Papon Nititharn, Commander of the 4402nd Ranger Corps and members of Civil Affairs Task Force together with Thala Mana Village Protection Unit went to support vulnerable people in Thung Yang Daeng District, Pattani Province.
